title: Icon for editing alternative text should agree with current CKEditor
description: Replay the editor states where the alternative-text icon appears: the image-insert control in the toolbar and the image widget once inserted. This data-step representation cannot upload an image, so the scenario records the toolbar control and stops there; the balloon's 'Edit alternative text' icon is compared by a person from a screenshot and from the upstream CKEditor 5 icon, and tools/playwright/evaluate-3419891.mjs can insert an image when a host-side file fixture is available.
preconditions: Standard install with CKEditor 5 image support, or the recipe used for #3419891 (Basic page body with image plugin).
No environment is registered for #3546089 yet; the issue is Active with no merge request in the lab's records.
The comparison icon is the current CKEditor 5 'insert image' / 'edit alternative text' icon set, not a description from memory.

fixture.notes: No recipe, folder or variant for #3546089 exists in this checkout. Plain Standard install is named as the intended fixture, but the Standard Basic page body uses Basic HTML without the image button; the #3419891 recipe (recipes/repro_3419891) is the realistic way to get an image-capable CKEditor 5 body. That is why the scenario is marked unverified and the fixture is stated as a precondition, not a fact.

resetInstructions: No registered environment: scaffold one with node scripts/new-issue.mjs 3546089 --branch <fix-branch>, then node tools/compare/setup.mjs 3546089-pinned.
Use the #3419891 recipe (recipes/repro_3419891) or equivalent image-capable CKEditor 5 configuration for the fixture.
manualReview: Insert an image (file upload is outside this vocabulary), select the image widget, open the balloon toolbar, and compare the 'Edit alternative text' icon with the icon in the current CKEditor 5 upstream build. 'Agree' means the same visual language and recognisable purpose, not just any icon.
Check the image dialog's own alternative text affordance as well, since the issue is about the icon used for editing alt text.
Check the icon at forced colours and in dark mode, where a background-image icon may disappear.
Screenshot both sides at the same state and inspect them side by side before calling anything changed.
